narr: A warm front stalled north of the Ohio Valley early on January 1st as a low pressure system developed near the area. These features brought widespread moderate to heavy rainfall to the area. A cold front associated with this low pressure system crossed through the Ohio Valley early on January 2nd, with rain continuing ahead of the front. Multiple roads throughout northeast Kentucky were closed for a time due to flooding. In front of a residence in Carter County, there was up to two feet of standing water and a few culverts overflowed due to high water.
ev: Portions of Kentucky Route 5 were impassable due to high water.
A portion of Trace Road was closed due to flooding.
A portion of Kentucky Route 469 was impassable due to flooding.
